g.text: Catalysts can share the fluid phase, occupy porous solids, or operate through enzymes

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Conceptual contact modes, not specific catalysts. Catalysts alter reaction pathways and kinetics but not equilibrium constants at fixed thermodynamic conditions.
Heterogeneous rates may be limited by external films or internal diffusion; enzyme operation depends on temperature, pH, inhibition and enzyme activity.
